summary: Tested the iter-14 scoring change on preview, both API and UI. WORKING: (1) A Primary round submitted with the untouched BHASHINI draft (all parts ticked) now gets Translation Quality 36.7/55 (matchPct 77, aiPct 57, judge claude-opus-5-5) and Timeliness 20/20 (time=1, not gated), score 80.1. The same submission without ticks through the UI gets TQ 38.5/55 (match 77, AI 63) and Timeliness 0/20, because completion is 0/100 parts. (2) The blend is exact: measures.quality = 0.5*match + 0.5*ai, and qualityMarks = round(quality*55,1). This was checked on the Primary and Trial attempts. A Trial with the exact CAG Hindi gives match 100, AI 100, score 100. A Trial with about 11% of words dropped gives match 99, AI 35, TQ 37/55. (3) Credits = best/100 × cap: Primary 80.1 → 4.0 and Trial 76.2 → 2.3. (4) Report card: the TQ subtitle reads '77% match with CAG's Hindi · AI review 57%'. 'Needs a 10% quality gain' is gone. The Timeliness subtitle shows 'N/M parts · x / 60 min'. (5) Weak spots: the report shows weak-spots with 3 items, and the review shows weak-spots plus 3 review-weak-* borders. Review weakSpots equal report weakSpots. (6) The interstitial works: the MISSION COMPLETE stamp, then the SCORING bars (TQ 38.5/55, then the others), then the card. (7) Latency: API submits took 2–5 s. The UI submit took 17.6 s from 'Submit anyway?' to reaching the report. (8) The auto-submit rule is correct in current code: after rescore.ts, my auto-submitted Trial scored time 0.5, Timeliness 10/20, score 90. Shared vitest: 28/28 pass. ISSUE FOUND: an auto-submitted attempt was scored by an OLD build, not this preview.

critical.issue: Another running deployment with OLD scoring code auto-submits due attempts from the same DATABASE_URL. My Trial c2def1ae (qa.cr21) was auto-submitted with result.counts holding 'timelinessGated' and no matchPct/aiPct; that key does not exist anywhere in the current source. It also had measures.time=0 (old rule) and score 80 instead of 90. Whichever instance's 30 s job runs first scores the attempt, so real players' time-ran-out attempts keep getting old-rule scores until that deployment is updated. One other attempt in the last 3 days (trial, auto_submitted=t) was scored by the new code.

minor.issue: Trial per-sentence weak spots pair the player's sentences with CAG's by splitting on । and matching by position. If the player drops or merges one danda, every later sentence is misaligned and shows '0% match with CAG's Hindi' with large lost marks (−9.5, −5, −4.8). Overall matchPct was 99% in the same attempt.
Match is very lenient: dropping every 9th word of the CAG Hindi still gives matchPct 99 (the AI judge gave 35). In practice the AI half carries most of the signal.

Worst case is Opus 60 s + Sonnet 45 s = 105 s inside the submit request. This can exceed ingress or proxy timeouts. Round.tsx then catches the error and navigates to /report while the attempt is still being scored or active, so /report returns 409. Report.tsx then shows a spinner forever (there is no error or retry state).

Submitting BHASHINI's draft untouched now earns the title: 80.1 with all parts ticked, 62 without ticks. That gives 4 of 5 credits for no editing. This follows the user's chosen rule, but flag it to the user.

integration_issues.issue: There is a 17.6 s wait between 'Submit anyway?' and the report while the judge runs. Only the button state changes; there is no explicit 'Scoring…' overlay during the wait.

issues: The TQ subtitle wraps to 2 lines at 1920px ('77% match with CAG's Hindi / · AI review 57%'). The '·' starts the second line. It is acceptable, but a non-breaking join would read better.

action_items: Stop or update the other deployment that shares DATABASE_URL (old code with 'timelinessGated'): its autoSubmitDue scores time-ran-out attempts with the old rules. After that, run rescore.ts to fix any attempts that lack counts.matchPct.

Align Trial weak spots robustly (e.g. match hyp sentences to ref by best similarity, or fall back to part-level when the sentence counts differ) so one missing danda does not show 0% for later sentences.
Cap the total judge time in submit (e.g. overall 30–40 s, then fall back to match-only). In Report.tsx, handle a 409/not_submitted report with a retry or poll instead of an endless spinner.
Optional: show a 'Scoring your Hindi…' overlay while submit awaits the judge. Raise the issue with the user that an untouched Primary draft earns the title (80/100).
critical_code_review_comments: game.ts submit(): the judge runs before the guarded UPDATE, so concurrent submits (UI + auto job) each call the LLM. The result is correct (status='active' guard) but costly. Consider claiming the attempt first (status='scoring').

judge.ts: the overall score is weighted only over the picked items (MAX_ITEMS 40 / 16k chars). On long Pro pages the unjudged parts do not count in the AI half, while the match half covers the full page.
scoring.ts: 'gain' and 'draftSimilarityPct' are still computed and stored but are unused for marks. They are fine as info.
The AI judge is non-deterministic: two untouched Primary submissions gave aiPct 57 and 63 (the pages may differ). Consider temperature 0 if the proxy supports it.

success_rate.backend: 90% (5/6 pytest pass; the 1 failure was my own threshold aiPct>=50 on a deliberately damaged text, not a bug; auto-submit scored by a stale external instance)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md: OTP was planted via test-otp.sh / iter11_helpers.plant, then POST /api/auth/otp/verify.

I ran rescore.ts (non-dry) once. Its dry run confirmed it touched only 1 row, my c2def1ae attempt. No other data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_quality_blend.py -p no:xdist -o addopts='' -s` with ITER14_EMAIL set to a fresh @cag.gov.in address. `python iter14_extra.py auto <email>` tests the auto-submit path: it moves that attempt's deadline and polls. Check result.counts for matchPct and the absence of timelinessGated to see which build scored it. Browser login: page.request.post(ABSOLUTE_URL + '/api/auth/otp/verify') after test-otp.sh. Each browser_automation call is a fresh context. Primary UI submit: the 'Start mission' button, then 'Submit Translation', then 'Submit anyway?'.
rca of the issue: Stale auto-submit: attempts.result for c2def1ae contains counts.timelinessGated=false, and `grep -rn timelinessGated /app/apps /app/packages` finds nothing. The only local API process is PID 45573 (src/server.ts, current code). So another deployment (e.g. the published production app) running the pre-iter14 build polls the same Neon DB every 30 s and auto-submits due attempts first. Repro: start a Trial, autosave, set deadline_at to the past, wait about 30 s, then inspect result.counts. Mitigation: redeploy or stop that instance, then run rescore.ts (it skips attempts that already have matchPct).
